nodes.description: Interface reference to the TokenTransferProxy contract used by routers to pull user tokens.
Payable address that collects Paraswap/partner fees; writable only by admin.
Mapping of partner address to FeeStructure holding share, fee percent and metadata.
Mapping from function selector to the whitelisted router implementation used by the fallback delegatecall.
Flags whether a given adapter key has already been initialized.
Stored initialization payload for each router key.
Flags whether a given router key has already been initialized.
Access-control role required for an address to be used as an adapter.
Access-control role required for an address to be registered as a router implementation.
Core role storage: per-role member set and admin role used by all role checks.
Root admin role (0x00) that is its own admin and can grant/revoke any role.
Owner address gating onlyOwner protected functions.
Array backing an enumerable set; mutated by push/pop and index math.
1-based index mapping for set membership and O(1) removal.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, admin and role authorization checks.
Transaction origin used as an authorization primitive inside TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.
onlyOwner function moving arbitrary tokens from an attacker-influenced 'from' address; validates from == tx.origin or isContract.
Payable fallback that resolves a router via selector and delegatecalls it with raw msg.data.
Empty payable receive function accepting plain ETH transfers.
Deploys TokenTransferProxy, stores fee wallet and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the deployer.
onlyAdmin function delegatecalling arbitrary calldata into a whitelisted adapter.
onlyAdmin function delegatecalling arbitrary calldata into a whitelisted router.

onlyAdmin setter for the fee wallet address with zero-address guard.
View returning the router implementation mapped to a selector.
Grants a role after checking the caller holds the role's admin role.
Revokes a role after checking the caller holds the role's admin role.
Allows an account to renounce its own role, requiring account == msg.sender.
Internal role grant with no authorization check, intended for constructors only.
Checks membership of an account in a role's enumerable member set.
Internal setter changing the admin role controlling a role.
Modifier comparing _owner with _msgSender() to restrict access.
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to a non-zero new owner.
onlyOwner function permanently clearing the owner.
Sends ETH to a recipient via full-gas call after a balance check.
Performs a value-transferring low-level call and verifies the result.
Uses extcodesize assembly to decide whether an address holds code.
Low-level call to a token contract tolerating empty return data; entry point for external token interaction.
Transfers ETH via a 10000-gas low-level call or ERC20 via safeTransfer.
Forwards a 224-byte blob as an IERC20Permit.permit call to an arbitrary token address.
Resets and increases token allowance using safeApprove and safeIncreaseAllowance.
Checked addition reverting on overflow.
Checked multiplication reverting on overflow.
Checked subtraction reverting on underflow.

delegatecall to a whitelisted adapter with admin-supplied calldata.
delegatecall to a whitelisted router with admin-supplied calldata.

recipient.call{value: amount} forwarding all gas and reverting on failure.
target.call{value: value}(data) arbitrary external call with value.
External call into an arbitrary token contract with attacker-influenced semantics.
Unchecked low-level call forwarding user-supplied permit data to a token.
Assembly revert/return bubbling raw returndata out of the fallback.
Inline assembly extcodesize check used to classify an address as a contract.
Authorization branch (from == tx.origin || from.isContract()) inside TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.

Router address passed to initializeRouter and used as delegatecall target.

Token address (or ETH sentinel) rescued by transferTokens.

Amount rescued by transferTokens.
Implementation address resolved from selectorVsRouter inside the fallback.
success/resultData captured from the router delegatecall.
Role identifier being granted.
Account receiving the role.
Swap-and-pop removal from the enumerable set performing index arithmetic.

edges.reason: msg.sender is evaluated via _msgSender() against the role admin before granting.
msg.sender is evaluated via _msgSender() against the role admin before revoking.
msg.sender must equal the account renouncing its own role.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender() which resolves to msg.sender.
Constructor grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender, the deployer.
tx.origin is read and used as the authorization primitive in the transferFrom guard.
The tx.origin branch gates which calls to transferFrom proceed to the token transfer.
from == tx.origin lets an attacker-controlled origin bypass the contract-code requirement.
transferFrom triggers an external token call through SafeERC20, allowing re-entry before state settles.
_callOptionalReturn performs the low-level external call into the token contract.
_callOptionalReturn delegates the actual call to Address.functionCall/functionCallWithValue.
functionCallWithValue executes target.call{value: value}(data).
functionCallWithValue requires isContract(target) before calling.
isContract uses the extcodesize assembly block to classify the address.
The fallback delegatecalls the resolved router with raw msg.data, giving it full control of the proxy state.
msg.sig-derived selector is used to look up the router implementation.
selectorVsRouter mapping is read while resolving the implementation.
getImplementation returns the router address into the local variable.
The resolved implementation address becomes the delegatecall target.
The fallback returns or reverts using the assembly data bubbling helpers.
initializeAdapter delegatecalls admin-supplied data into a whitelisted adapter.
The adapter address parameter is the delegatecall target.
initializeAdapter requires the adapter to hold WHITELISTED_ROLE.
initializeRouter delegatecalls admin-supplied data into a whitelisted router.
The router address parameter is the delegatecall target.
initializeRouter requires the router to hold ROUTER_ROLE.
setImplementation requires the implementation to hold ROUTER_ROLE.
The implementation parameter is validated and stored.
The selector parameter indexes the selectorVsRouter mapping write.
Only the admin can repoint a selector to a new router implementation.
The admin rescue path sends ETH with a low-level call that can re-enter.
setFeeWallet replaces the feeWallet state variable.
feeWallet can only be modified by an admin caller.
The constructor stores the freshly deployed TokenTransferProxy in tokenTransferProxy.
The constructor deploys TokenTransferProxy which owns transferFrom.
DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the default admin checked when granting roles.
hasRole reads the _roles membership set for the queried role.
grantRole reverts unless hasRole(adminRole, msg.sender) is true.
revokeRole reverts unless hasRole(adminRole, msg.sender) is true.
The constructor calls _setupRole to bootstrap the admin role without an authorization check.
_setupRole writes membership and admin data into _roles.
_setRoleAdmin rewrites the adminRole field of _roles.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable for comparison.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner.
renounceOwnership clears _owner to address(0).
_values.length - 1 feeds the checked subtraction computing lastIndex.
valueIndex - 1 is computed with SafeMath.sub to derive the deletion index.
_remove computes the cached valueIndex used in the index arithmetic.
_remove computes lastIndex from the array length.
lastIndex + 1 is written back into the _indexes mapping for the moved value.
_add pushes the new value onto the _values array.
_add stores the 1-based index of the value in _indexes.
_at reads the element at the requested index from _values.
Utils.transferTokens forwards ETH with a low-level 10000-gas call.
sendValue performs a full-gas value call to the recipient.
Utils.permit forwards user-supplied data through an unchecked low-level call.
approve relies on SafeMath.add when increasing the allowance.
Token parameter selects between ETH transfer and ERC20 safeTransfer.
Destination parameter is the recipient of the rescued funds.
Amount parameter controls how much is transferred out.
Token parameter selects the ERC20 contract to transfer.
From parameter is the debited account and the tx.origin comparison operand.
To parameter receives the transferred tokens.
Amount parameter is forwarded to safeTransferFrom.
Role parameter selects which role is granted and whose admin is checked.
Account parameter is the address added to the role member set.
Partner parameter keys the registeredPartners mapping write.
feePercent parameter is range-checked then stored for the partner.
registerPartner writes partner fee data only when called by an admin.
success and resultData capture the delegatecall outcome handled in the fallback.
transferFrom is onlyOwner, so msg.sender must equal the owning swapper contract.
The token external call is routed through Address.functionCallWithValue.

normalization_plan.reason: token parameter of transferFrom is only meaningful within that function's transfer flow.
from parameter is the untrusted account compared to tx.origin inside transferFrom.
to parameter is consumed directly by the safeTransferFrom call in transferFrom.
amount parameter is consumed directly by the safeTransferFrom call in transferFrom.
msg.sig-derived selector exists only to resolve the router inside the fallback.
adapter parameter is the delegatecall target of initializeAdapter.
router parameter is the delegatecall target of initializeRouter.
implementation parameter is the router address stored by setImplementation.
selector parameter is the mapping key written by setImplementation.
partner parameter is the mapping key written by registerPartner.
_feePercent parameter is validated and stored by registerPartner.
token parameter drives the branch in AugustusSwapper.transferTokens.
destination parameter is the receiver in AugustusSwapper.transferTokens.
amount parameter controls the value sent by AugustusSwapper.transferTokens.
the resolved implementation local is the delegatecall target of the fallback.
success/resultData locals only carry the delegatecall outcome of the fallback.
role parameter scopes the admin lookup performed by grantRole.
account parameter is the grantee written by grantRole.
valueIndex local is produced and consumed inside EnumerableSet._remove.
lastIndex local is produced and consumed inside EnumerableSet._remove.
